blocks.x: Patient Priority Portal's architecture: the planes, the controls and the evidence export — documented the way your auditors will read it.
Structurally Patient Priority Portal is planes, not layers — workload, decision and evidence run in parallel behind one governed API, and each crossing is logged with policy version and owner.

blocks.x: Runtime dependencies: Hyperledger Fabric/Besu, HSM fleets, W3C VC/DID, static/formal verification tools. Deployment runs inside your security perimeter with customer-managed keys; the evidence export is formatted for the audit formats your team already uses.

Deployment models for Patient Priority Portal follow the estate: in-perimeter on customer-managed keys, or in a segregated enclave where the estate cannot host the workload. Either way the control pack, the replay log and the audit export keep the same format, so the second deployment never re-argues the first.
A value assessment prices the delta in your estate before anything is signed: Patient Priority Portal architecture, measured against your baseline, in two weeks.
